user: I've decided I want Conversation.parts (Message[]) to be its own `messages` DB table. It needs the following columns. They are non-nullable unless specified.

* id (server-autogenerated UUID)
* conversationId (FK to conversations.id, cascade deletion of that to this)
* index (integer, with unique index based on conversation_id)
* createdAt (date time with zone)
* updatedAt (date time with zone)

and then the following encrypted fields, which each need both a *Encrypted and *Iv bytea column:

* sender
* text
* modelId (nullable)
* tokenUsage (nullable)

Don't bother with migrating any preexisting data, I will be dropping the columns.

agent: I've added the `messages` table to the schema with all the required columns:

* `id` - UUID with default random generation (primary key)
* `conversationId` - UUID foreign key to `conversations.id` with cascade delete
* `index` - integer for message ordering within a conversation
* `createdAt` and `updatedAt` - timestamps with timezone
* Encrypted fields with both Encrypted and IV columns:
  * `senderEncrypted` / `senderIv` (non-nullable)
  * `textEncrypted` / `textIv` (non-nullable)
  * `modelIdEncrypted` / `modelIdIv` (nullable)
  * `tokenUsageEncrypted` / `tokenUsageIv` (nullable)

I've also created a unique index on `(conversationId, index)` to ensure message ordering is unique within each conversation.

The schema is ready. You can generate a migration using Drizzle Kit when you're ready to apply it to the database.
